structuralFindings.finding: The existing primitive graph has no color-matrix parameter type. Add a precise immutable matrix value and validate external numbers at the definition boundary; do not repurpose blur, offset or flood fields.

SvgFilterColorTransfer performs color-space transfer on premultiplied samples. A matrix also mixes channels and changes alpha; it needs its own bounded arithmetic kernel, with temporary unpremultiplication and subsequent premultiplication. Reuse existing transfer stages rather than folding them through matrix/clamp boundaries.

Source, stored-image, construction and output extents already have separate metadata. A matrix capable of making transparent input opaque can affect its primitive region beyond source ink. Do not inherit the ordinary source-only output bound unconditionally.

Deferred source color filters use a small enum for existing operations. An arbitrary matrix must retain operation order, color space, crop coverage and byte-storage boundaries; do not collapse it into an existing enum value or snap affine maps.
Reuse the existing filter frame/surface admission and cancellation lifecycle. Matrix coefficients need no new resource provider, cache, scene owner or replay pipeline.
